## [0.5.2] - 2026-08-16

### Fixed

- Cache the Cloudflare Access identity per issued token, to stop repeated write-conflict errors on page load ([#925](https://github.com/solarssk/admitto/pull/925))
- Show the branded error page instead of a bare "Forbidden" when access is denied ([#926](https://github.com/solarssk/admitto/pull/926))

---

### Deploy
- Container image: `ghcr.io/solarssk/admitto:0.5.2` (rolling `:0.5`)
- Migrations apply **automatically on container start**. **No manual `migrate deploy`.** Back up the database yourself before upgrading (the stack no longer takes an automatic pre-migration backup).

[Full changelog](https://github.com/solarssk/admitto/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md)
